<!-- head-1: body_md -->
\emph{The JCAS CP $\mathcal{P}_{cs}(\theta_c, \theta_s)$, is defined as the probability that the received SIR of the communication and sensing functions at the receiving UAV-BS are simultaneously not less than a predefined threshold $\theta_c$ and $\theta_s$ required for successful communication and tracking, respectively, i.e., $\mathcal{P}_{cs}(\theta_c, \theta_s)  \triangleq \mathbb{P}[ {\rm{SIR}}_{c}>\theta_c, {\rm{SIR}}_s>\theta_s]$. }
<!-- end head-1 -->
<!-- head-2: body_md -->
\emph{Let $\mathbf{p}_i$ denote the 3D spatial location of the $i$-th UAV-UE in terms of the spherical coordinates $(r,\theta,\phi)$ in $\mathcal{C}(L,R)$. The joint PDF $f_{\mathbf{p}_i}(r,\theta,\phi)$ is given by }
\begin{equation}
f_{\mathbf{p}_i}(r,\theta,\phi) = \frac{r^2 \sin(\theta)}{V},
\end{equation}
\emph{where $V=\pi R^2L$ and $\theta \in[0,\pi]$, $\phi \in [-\pi,\pi]$,  $r \in [0,r_{\max}(\theta,\phi)]$ and $r_{\max}(\theta,\phi) = \min\Big\{  \frac{L/2}{|\sin(\theta)\cos(\phi)|},\frac{R}{\sqrt{1-\sin^2(\theta)\cos^2(\phi)}} \Big\}$.}
<!-- end head-2 -->
<!-- head-3: body_md -->
Refer to Appendix A. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-3 -->
<!-- head-4: body_md -->
\emph{Conditioned on the location  $\mathbf{p}_0$ of the tracked UAV-UE, the conditional Laplace transform  $\mathcal{L}_{I_s}(s|\mathbf{p}_0)$ of the aggregate clutter interference power distribution is given by \eqref{eqLTs}, shown at the bottom of the page, where $r_i= ||\mathbf{w}_i||$ and $f_{\mathbf{p}_i}(r_i,\theta_i,\phi_i)$ is given by Lemma 1.}
<!-- end head-4 -->
<!-- head-5: body_md -->
Refer to Appendix B.
<!-- end head-5 -->
<!-- head-6: body_md -->
\emph{The conditional sensing CP $\mathcal{P}_{s}(\theta_s|\mathbf{p}_0)$ of the UAV-BS is given by}
\begin{equation} \tag{6}
\begin{split}
\mathcal{P}_{s}(\theta_s|\mathbf{p}_0) = &\int_{0}^{\infty} \sum_{k=0}^{m - 1}  \frac{{(-m \theta_s)}^k }{ (\sigma_0 g_{{\rm{max}}}^2 l^2(||\mathbf{w}_0||))^k k!} \\
&\times {\Bigg[ \frac{\partial^{k} \mathcal{L}_{I_s}(s|\mathbf{p}_0)}{\partial{s^k}}\Bigg]}_{s_0}f_{\sigma_0}(\sigma_0) {\rm{d}}  \sigma_0,  
\end{split}
\end{equation}
\emph{for $s_0 = \frac{m \theta_s}{\sigma_0 g_{{\rm{max}}}^2l^2(||\mathbf{w}_0||)}$ and $||\mathbf{w}_0|| = r_0$}.
<!-- end head-6 -->
<!-- head-7: body_md -->
The proof for deriving Proposition 1 follows conceptual lines similar to those presented in \cite[Theorem 1]{TWC} and thus is omitted here for brevity.  \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-7 -->
<!-- head-8: body_md -->
\emph{The conditional Laplace transform  $\mathcal{L}_{I_c}(s|\
\mathbf{p}_0)$ of the aggregate interference power distribution is given by \eqref{eqLTc}, shown at the bottom of the page.}
<!-- end head-8 -->
<!-- head-9: body_md -->
The proof for deriving Lemma 3 follows a similar procedure as the proof for deriving Lemma 2. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-9 -->
<!-- head-10: body_md -->
\emph{The conditional communication CP $\mathcal{P}_{s}(\theta_s|\mathbf{p}_0)$ of the UAV-BS is given by}
\begin{align} \tag{8}
\mathcal{P}_{c}(\theta_c|\mathbf{p}_0) = &\sum_{k=0}^{m - 1}  \frac{{(-m \theta_c)}^k }{( g_{{\rm{max}}} l(||\mathbf{w}_0||))^k k!} {\Bigg[ \frac{\partial^{k} \mathcal{L}_{I_c}(s|\mathbf{p}_0)}{\partial{s^k}}\Bigg]}_{s_0}, \nonumber 
\end{align}
\emph{for $s_0 = \frac{m \theta_c}{ g_{{\rm{max}}} l(||\mathbf{w}_0||)}$ and $||\mathbf{w}_0|| = r_0$}.
<!-- end head-10 -->
<!-- head-11: body_md -->
The proof for deriving Proposition 2 follows conceptual lines similar to those of the proof presented in \cite[Theorem 1]{TWC}. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-11 -->
<!-- head-12: body_md -->
Recalling Definition 1, the JCAS CP is given by
\begin{equation} \tag{10} \label{proofTh1}
\begin{split}
&\mathcal{P}_{cs}(\theta_c, \theta_s) = \mathbb{E}[\mathds{1}({\rm{SIR}}_{c} \geq \theta_c) \times \mathds{1}({\rm{SIR}}_{s} \geq \theta_s)] \\
&\mathrel{\stackrel{\makebox[0pt]{\mbox{\normalfont\scriptsize (a)}}}{=}}  \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{p}_0}[\mathds{1}({\rm{SIR}}_{c} \geq \theta_c | \mathbf{p}_0) \times \mathds{1}({\rm{SIR}}_{s} \geq \theta_s |\mathbf{p}_0] \\
&  \mathrel{\stackrel{\makebox[0pt]{\mbox{\normalfont\scriptsize (b)}}}{=}} \mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{p}_0}[\mathbb{P}({\rm{SIR}}_{c} \geq \theta_c |\mathbf{p}_0) \times \mathbb{P}({\rm{SIR}}_{s} \geq \theta_s |\mathbf{p}_0)],
\end{split}
\end{equation}
where (a) follows directly from the independence of the point process of interfering UAV-UEs $\Phi^!$ and $\Psi$ for sensing and communication, respectively, (b) follows after applying the indicator function which results to be the product of the conditional coverage probabilities that have been proved in Proposition 1 and Proposition 2. After substituting Proposition 1 and Proposition 2 in \eqref{proofTh1} and applying the expectation on \eqref{proofTh1} to jointly decondition over the location of the tracked UAV-UE $\mathbf{p}_0$ w.r.t $f_{\mathbf{p}_0}(r_0, \theta_0,  \phi_0)$, Theorem 1 is obtained. \null\nobreak\hfill\ensuremath{\blacksquare}
<!-- end head-12 -->
<!-- head-13: body_md -->
\emph{The results obtained in Proposition 1 and Proposition 2 can be exploited to directly investigate the marginal sensing and coverage probabilities, respectively, for a fixed or random 3D position of the tracked UAV-UE. This is a first step towards the investigation of simpler yet more tractable frameworks that enable the derivation of closed-form expressions for JCAS coverage probability.}
<!-- end head-13 -->
